deps: Upgrade dev dependencies and actions (#269)

TypeScript 6, eslint 10, vitest 5.0.5, rollup 4.65, typedoc 0.28 and
the rest. @ctrl/eslint-config is stuck on eslint 8, so this moves to a
flat config with typescript-eslint, prettier and the same import
sorting. TypeScript stops at 6 since typedoc and typescript-eslint
don't support 7 yet.

ts-node can't compile build.ts under TS 6, node runs it directly now.
Also bumps setup-node to 7.1.0 and pnpm to 12.15.0.
